disclaimer: A machine PASS means: veraPDF found no PDF/UA-1 machine-checkable failure and our triage found no failing check. It is NOT a conformance claim. Roughly a third of the Matterhorn Protocol failure conditions (47 of 136) need human judgment, and WCAG 2.1 AA has criteria no tool can decide. Every file still needs the manual checks listed below, with NVDA, before delivery.

top_verapdf_rules.description: Content shall be marked as Artifact or tagged as real content
Natural language for text in page content shall be determined
Every page on which there is an annotation shall contain in its page dictionary the key Tabs, and its value shall be S
The PDF/UA version and conformance level of a file shall be specified using the PDF/UA Identification extension schema
The document catalog dictionary shall include a ViewerPreferences dictionary containing a DisplayDocTitle key, whose value shall be true
A form field shall have a TU key present or all its Widget annotations shall have alternative descriptions (in the form of an Alt entry in the enclosing structure elements)
A Widget annotation shall be nested within a Form tag per ISO 32000-1:2008, 14.8.4.5, Table 340
The document catalog dictionary shall include a MarkInfo dictionary containing an entry, Marked, whose value shall be true

The Metadata stream in the document's catalog dictionary shall contain a dc:title entry, where dc is the recommended prefix for the Dublin Core metadata schema as defined in the XMP specification, which clearly identifies the document
The logical structure of the conforming file shall be described by a structure hierarchy rooted in the StructTreeRoot entry of the document catalog dictionary, as described in ISO 32000-1:2008, 14.7
Natural language in the TU key for form fields shall be determined
Natural language for text in E attribute shall be determined
The Font dictionary of all fonts shall define the map of all used character codes to Unicode values, either via a ToUnicode entry, or other mechanisms as defined in ISO 14289-1, 7.21.7
Table rows shall have the same number of columns (taking into account column spans)
Natural language for document metadata shall be determined

manual_checks_required.check: Reading order matches the visual/logical order
manual_checks_required.how: NVDA: read the whole document with Down Arrow / say-all (NVDA+Down Arrow); compare with the visual layout, including multi-column text, sidebars, callouts and footnotes. Check the Tags tree order in Acrobat or PAC (Logical structure / Screen reader preview).

manual_checks_required.check: Tags match meaning (headings, lists, paragraphs, links, notes)
manual_checks_required.how: NVDA: H / Shift+H to walk headings, NVDA+F7 elements list (headings, links), L / I for lists. Heading levels must reflect the outline and must not skip levels without reason.

manual_checks_required.check: Alternative text is accurate and equivalent; decorative images are artifacts
manual_checks_required.how: NVDA: G / Shift+G to move between graphics; listen to every alt text. Charts/infographics need the data or the conclusion, not 'chart'. Logos, rules and backgrounds must not be announced.

manual_checks_required.check: Headers, footers, page numbers and decorations are artifacts
manual_checks_required.how: NVDA say-all must not repeat running headers/footers/page numbers in the middle of content.

manual_checks_required.check: Table headers and associations are correct
manual_checks_required.how: NVDA: T to reach each table, Ctrl+Alt+arrows to move cell by cell: every data cell must announce its row/column headers. Complex tables need Scope or Headers/IDs; layout tables must not be tagged as Table.

manual_checks_required.check: Form fields: names, roles, required state, tab order
manual_checks_required.how: NVDA: Tab through every field; each one announces a meaningful name (TU), its type and state; the Tab order follows the visual order; instructions and errors are reachable.

manual_checks_required.check: Links are tagged, work, and their purpose is clear
manual_checks_required.how: NVDA: K / NVDA+F7 links list; every link announces meaningful text and opens the right target.

manual_checks_required.check: Document language and language changes are correct
manual_checks_required.how: Check /Lang (Document Properties > Advanced) and that passages in another language carry their own Lang; NVDA must switch voice when automatic language switching is on.

manual_checks_required.check: Color contrast and use of color
manual_checks_required.how: Measure text and essential graphics with a contrast checker (4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text and graphical objects); information is not conveyed by color alone.

manual_checks_required.check: Bookmarks exist for long documents and match the headings
manual_checks_required.how: Open the Bookmarks pane: entries follow the heading structure and jump to the right place.

manual_checks_required.check: Title is meaningful and shown in the window title
manual_checks_required.how: The window title shows the document title (not the file name); title describes the content.

manual_checks_required.check: Text is read correctly (no garbled characters, ligatures or merged words)
manual_checks_required.how: NVDA say-all and character navigation on special characters, ligatures, symbols and math; copy-paste a sample paragraph into a plain-text editor.
Compare recognized text against the page image; fix misrecognised words, numbers and dates.

manual_checks_required.check: The remediated file looks like the original
manual_checks_required.how: Compare page by page with the source: no lost content, moved objects or changed fonts.
NVDA (latest) with Adobe Acrobat Reader: read start to finish, navigate by headings, tables, lists, links and form fields. Optionally repeat with JAWS. Note any confusion as a defect.
